A '''reptilian species''' was from the planet [[Davnar II/Legends|Davnar II]]. They were bipedal and covered in scales, with long snouts. The [[Species/Legends|species]] as a whole was highly regarded for their flair for execution. A Davnarian was employed by the [[loan shark]] [[Ploovo Two-For-One/Legends|Ploovo Two-For-One]] as a bodyguard during his encounter with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].
